plan.title: Closed RFQ surrogate bid after expiry

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on its Participants tab, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable the company setting required for surrogate bids after expiry.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case configuration.
Attempt to add the buyer-entered bid at 95 for Vendor A; this also performs the save and reports whether the closed-round restriction permits it.
Verify the buyer-side response grid marks a response as a surrogate bid if the bid was accepted.
